enisa_sme_maturity.title: SME Cyber Resilience Maturity Assessment Model
enisa_sme_maturity.scope: Supplemental CRA/product-security maturity model, primarily for manufacturers placing products with digital elements on the market and other product-lifecycle organisations.
enisa_sme_maturity.use: Supplemental product-security extension; not a universal organisational cybersecurity baseline.

nis2.title: Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (NIS2)
nis2.scope: EU legal source; obligations apply only where the assessed entity falls within the Directive and applicable national transposition.
nis2.use: Regulatory relevance, not a universal requirement for all organisations.
